summary: PR 554 at 383ee41aaa252f8f081d0b6a860f2c8f051f1cb0 preserves both branches in a useful single-scf.if characterization, but it is not a fix for the reported six-instance production failure. The exact test passes unchanged on the prepared base and candidate with identical gfx950 LLVM IR and ISA: 32 vector phis, 160 MFMAs, 33 unique MFMA destination groups, 138 VGPRs, and zero spills. The production MLA test is environment-blocked by the prepared aiter requiring Triton >=3.6.0 while the pinned environment provides 3.5.1+rocm7.2.0.gita272dfa8. No speculative lowering change was made.

tests.what_was_measured: Untouched base on assigned gfx950: exact analytical numerical match; 32 phi <4 x float>; 160 MFMAs; 33 unique MFMA destination groups; 138 VGPRs; zero spills.
Untouched base gfx942 cross-codegen: 32 vector phis; 160 MFMAs; 33 unique destinations; 138 VGPRs; zero spills. No gfx942 execution.
Exact candidate commit on gfx950: same numerical and compiler metrics as base. Base/candidate SHA-256 matched for LLVM IR (635bbb55...) and final ISA (95638592...).
Production MLA collection is blocked because prepared aiter requires triton>=3.6.0 but the pinned environment has 3.5.1+rocm7.2.0.gita272dfa8.

gpu_execution_evidence: The retained single-if characterization executed on the assigned gfx950 GPU and exactly matched an independently constructed Torch result. The production MLA kernel and gfx942 were not executed.
remaining_limitations: The production pattern has six branch instances and surrounding register pressure absent from the retained characterization. Its test cannot be collected in the prepared environment because of the pinned aiter/Triton mismatch. Thus production register/spill counts and numerical output remain unverified. gfx942 evidence is cross-compiled only. No failing-before/passing-after compiler regression exists, and mutable physical-register semantics for memref_alloca(Register) are not implemented.
